api/src/routers/auth.py.name: Sign-in and accounts
api/src/routers/auth.py.description: Handles signing in, staying signed in, two-step codes, passkeys, invites and command-line sign-ins.

api/src/routers/authorization.py.name: My permissions
api/src/routers/authorization.py.description: Tells the screens what the signed-in person may do, so controls they cannot use stay hidden.

api/src/routers/branding.py.name: Platform look
api/src/routers/branding.py.description: Sets the platform's name, main colour and logos, with one-click resets back to the factory look.

api/src/routers/chat.py.name: Assistant chat
api/src/routers/chat.py.description: Runs the assistant chat: conversations, replies, file attachments and generated files.

api/src/routers/claims.py.name: Custom claims
api/src/routers/claims.py.description: Stores reusable named claims about people or organizations for workflows and access rules to rely on.

api/src/routers/cli.py.name: Command-line services
api/src/routers/cli.py.description: Gives command-line tools and workflows what they need: settings, connection details, documents, AI answers and knowledge search.

api/src/routers/config.py.name: Settings values
api/src/routers/config.py.description: Keeps the named settings that workflows and connections read, for the whole platform or one organization.

api/src/routers/decorator_properties.py.name: Workflow trigger settings
api/src/routers/decorator_properties.py.description: Reads and saves the settings written on a workflow's trigger line, such as when it runs or what it is called.

api/src/routers/dependencies.py.name: What depends on what
api/src/routers/dependencies.py.description: Shows which records use a workflow, form, app or table, so you can see what a change would affect.

api/src/routers/docs.py.name: Documentation feed
api/src/routers/docs.py.description: Serves all of the platform's help documentation as one page that AI assistants can read.

POST /auth/login.name: Sign in
POST /auth/login.description: Checks an email and password, then either signs you in or asks for your second code.

POST /auth/mfa/setup.name: Set up two-step codes
POST /auth/mfa/setup.description: Starts setting up an authenticator app during first-time account setup.

POST /auth/mfa/verify.name: Confirm two-step setup
POST /auth/mfa/verify.description: Checks the first code from your authenticator app to finish turning on two-step sign-in.

POST /auth/mfa/login.name: Enter second code
POST /auth/mfa/login.description: Checks the code from your authenticator app and finishes signing you in.

POST /auth/impersonate/{user_id}.name: Sign in as someone
POST /auth/impersonate/{user_id}.description: Lets a platform administrator see the platform as another person, with the switch recorded.

POST /auth/impersonation/end.name: Stop acting as someone
POST /auth/impersonation/end.description: Returns a platform administrator to their own account, even after the switch expired.

POST /auth/refresh.name: Stay signed in
POST /auth/refresh.description: Issues a fresh sign-in pass as the old one ages out, without asking for a password.

GET /auth/me.name: Who am I
GET /auth/me.description: Shows the signed-in person's name, email, roles and organization.

POST /auth/logout.name: Sign out
POST /auth/logout.description: Ends the current sign-in and cancels the pass that kept you signed in.

POST /auth/revoke-all.name: Sign out everywhere
POST /auth/revoke-all.description: Cancels every sign-in for your account on all devices.

POST /auth/admin/revoke-user.name: Sign someone out
POST /auth/admin/revoke-user.description: Cancels every sign-in for a chosen person, for administrators handling a lost device.

POST /auth/register.name: Create an account
POST /auth/register.description: Creates a new person's account and signs them in.

GET /auth/status.name: Sign-in page status
GET /auth/status.description: Tells the sign-in page whether accounts exist yet and whether two-step codes are required.

POST /auth/device/code.name: Start command-line sign-in
POST /auth/device/code.description: Gives the command-line tool a short code to show you, starting the sign-in process.

POST /auth/device/token.name: Finish command-line sign-in
POST /auth/device/token.description: Checks whether a command-line sign-in was approved and hands over the sign-in pass.

POST /auth/setup/passkey/options.name: Start passkey setup
POST /auth/setup/passkey/options.description: Begins setting up fingerprint or face sign-in for the first administrator account.

POST /auth/setup/passkey/verify.name: Confirm passkey setup
POST /auth/setup/passkey/verify.description: Finishes setting up fingerprint or face sign-in for the first administrator account.

POST /auth/device/authorize.name: Approve command-line sign-in
POST /auth/device/authorize.description: Lets you confirm that a command-line sign-in request is really yours.

POST /auth/device/deny.name: Refuse command-line sign-in
POST /auth/device/deny.description: Rejects a command-line sign-in request you did not start.

POST /auth/register-from-invite.name: Join from an invite
POST /auth/register-from-invite.description: Uses a one-time invite link to create an account and sign in.

POST /auth/register-from-invite/passkey/.name: Start passkey from invite
POST /auth/register-from-invite/passkey/.description: Begins setting up fingerprint or face sign-in while joining from an invite.

POST /auth/register-from-invite/passkey/.name: Finish passkey from invite
POST /auth/register-from-invite/passkey/.description: Completes an invite sign-up using a passkey and signs the new person in.

GET /auth/authorization.name: My permissions
GET /auth/authorization.description: Lists what the signed-in person may do, so the screens can show or hide controls.

GET /api/branding.name: Current branding
GET /api/branding.description: Shows the platform's name, colour and logos, including on the sign-in page.

PUT /api/branding.name: Change branding
PUT /api/branding.description: Saves the platform's name and main colour.

POST /api/branding/logo/{logo_type}.name: Upload logo
POST /api/branding/logo/{logo_type}.description: Replaces the square or wide logo shown across the platform.

DELETE /api/branding/color.name: Reset colour
DELETE /api/branding/color.description: Puts the default main colour back.

DELETE /api/branding/application-name.name: Reset platform name
DELETE /api/branding/application-name.description: Puts the default platform name back.

DELETE /api/branding.name: Reset all branding
DELETE /api/branding.description: Returns the name, colour and logos to the factory look.

GET /api/chat/model-profiles.name: Chat model choices
GET /api/chat/model-profiles.description: Lists the approved model settings people can pick when starting a chat.

POST /api/chat/conversations.name: Start a chat
POST /api/chat/conversations.description: Opens a new conversation, with or without a chosen agent.

GET /api/chat/conversations.name: My chats
GET /api/chat/conversations.description: Lists your conversations, most recent first.

GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.name: Chat details
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.description: Shows one conversation's details and who it belongs to.

DELETE /api/chat/conversations/{conversa.name: Delete a chat
DELETE /api/chat/conversations/{conversa.description: Hides a conversation from your list without destroying the record.

POST /api/chat/runs.name: Send message to agent
POST /api/chat/runs.description: Saves your message and starts the agent's reply in the background so the screen can reconnect.

GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.name: Reconnect to a chat
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.description: Returns the full current state of a conversation so the screen can pick up where it left off.

POST /api/chat/runs/{run_id}/cancel.name: Stop a chat reply
POST /api/chat/runs/{run_id}/cancel.description: Cancels a reply that is still being worked on.

GET /api/chat/artifacts.name: My chat files
GET /api/chat/artifacts.description: Lists files you uploaded or the assistant created in chat.

PATCH /api/chat/artifacts/{attachment_id.name: Rename a chat file
PATCH /api/chat/artifacts/{attachment_id.description: Changes a chat file's name without moving the file itself.

DELETE /api/chat/artifacts/{attachment_i.name: Delete a chat file
DELETE /api/chat/artifacts/{attachment_i.description: Removes one of your chat files.

POST /api/chat/conversations/{conversati.name: Attach files to a message
POST /api/chat/conversations/{conversati.description: Checks and stores files you want to send with your next message.

DELETE /api/chat/conversations/{conversa.name: Remove an attachment
DELETE /api/chat/conversations/{conversa.description: Deletes a file you attached but never sent.

GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.name: Open an attachment
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.description: Shows or downloads an attached file after checking it belongs to your conversation.

GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.name: Chat messages
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conversatio.description: Lists the messages in a conversation in order.

POST /api/chat/conversations/{conversati.name: Send a message
POST /api/chat/conversations/{conversati.description: Sends a message and waits for the whole reply instead of streaming it.

GET /api/claims.name: Custom claims
GET /api/claims.description: Lists the named claims recorded for organizations, with a filter for administrators working across all of them.

GET /api/claims/{name}.name: Claim details
GET /api/claims/{name}.description: Shows one custom claim and its value.

POST /api/claims.name: Add a claim
POST /api/claims.description: Records a new named claim for an organization.

PATCH /api/claims/{name}.name: Update a claim
PATCH /api/claims/{name}.description: Changes a claim's value or description.

DELETE /api/claims/{name}.name: Delete a claim
DELETE /api/claims/{name}.description: Removes a claim that is no longer used.

GET /api/sdk/context.name: Command-line start-up details
GET /api/sdk/context.description: Tells the command-line tools which platform, organization and person they are working as.

POST /api/sdk/config/get.name: Read a setting
POST /api/sdk/config/get.description: Returns one saved setting so command-line tools can use it.

POST /api/sdk/config/set.name: Save a setting
POST /api/sdk/config/set.description: Stores a setting from the command line.

POST /api/sdk/config/list.name: List settings
POST /api/sdk/config/list.description: Lists the saved settings available to the command-line tools.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/get.name: Connection details
POST /api/sdk/integrations/get.description: Returns an organization's connection details for an outside service.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/list_mappings.name: Connection links
POST /api/sdk/integrations/list_mappings.description: Lists which organizations are linked to which outside accounts for a service.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/get_mapping.name: One connection link
POST /api/sdk/integrations/get_mapping.description: Returns the link between an organization and its outside account.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/upsert_mappin.name: Save a connection link
POST /api/sdk/integrations/upsert_mappin.description: Creates or updates the link between an organization and an outside account.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/delete_mappin.name: Remove a connection link
POST /api/sdk/integrations/delete_mappin.description: Deletes the link between an organization and an outside account.

POST /api/sdk/integrations/refresh_token.name: Renew a connection pass
POST /api/sdk/integrations/refresh_token.description: Asks an outside service for a fresh sign-in pass so workflows keep working.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts.name: Store a workflow file
POST /api/sdk/artifacts.description: Saves a file a workflow produced and gives back a reference to it.

GET /api/sdk/artifacts.name: Workflow files
GET /api/sdk/artifacts.description: Lists the files saved in one workflow run's workspace.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts/document.name: Make a document
POST /api/sdk/artifacts/document.description: Builds a PDF or Word document from workflow content and stores it.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts/spreadsheet.name: Make a spreadsheet
POST /api/sdk/artifacts/spreadsheet.description: Builds an Excel spreadsheet from workflow content and stores it.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts/text.name: Make a text file
POST /api/sdk/artifacts/text.description: Builds a plain text or comma-separated file from workflow content and stores it.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts/image.name: Generate an image
POST /api/sdk/artifacts/image.description: Asks the chosen image service to create a picture and stores it.

POST /api/sdk/artifacts/video.name: Generate a video
POST /api/sdk/artifacts/video.description: Starts making a video in the background and stores it when ready.

GET /api/sdk/artifacts/{artifact_id}/con.name: Read a workflow file
GET /api/sdk/artifacts/{artifact_id}/con.description: Returns a stored file after checking the caller may see it.

GET /api/sdk/artifacts/{artifact_id}/dow.name: Get a file download link
GET /api/sdk/artifacts/{artifact_id}/dow.description: Creates a link that works for a short time so a file can be downloaded.

POST /api/sdk/ai/complete.name: Ask the AI
POST /api/sdk/ai/complete.description: Gets one complete answer from the platform's chosen AI service.

POST /api/sdk/ai/stream.name: Ask AI with live output
POST /api/sdk/ai/stream.description: Gets an AI answer that arrives word by word as it is written.

GET /api/sdk/ai/info.name: AI service details
GET /api/sdk/ai/info.description: Shows which AI service and model the platform is using.

POST /api/sdk/knowledge/store.name: Add to knowledge
POST /api/sdk/knowledge/store.description: Saves a document in the searchable knowledge store so chat and workflows can find it.

POST /api/sdk/knowledge/store-many.name: Add many to knowledge
POST /api/sdk/knowledge/store-many.description: Saves several documents at once in the searchable knowledge store.

POST /api/sdk/knowledge/search.name: Search knowledge
POST /api/sdk/knowledge/search.description: Finds the most relevant stored documents for a question, using both words and meaning.

POST /api/sdk/knowledge/delete.name: Delete from knowledge
POST /api/sdk/knowledge/delete.description: Removes one stored document from the knowledge store.

DELETE /api/sdk/knowledge/namespace/{nam.name: Clear a knowledge group
DELETE /api/sdk/knowledge/namespace/{nam.description: Deletes every document in one knowledge group.

GET /api/sdk/knowledge/namespaces.name: Knowledge groups
GET /api/sdk/knowledge/namespaces.description: Lists the knowledge groups with how many documents each holds.

GET /api/sdk/knowledge/get.name: Read a knowledge document
GET /api/sdk/knowledge/get.description: Returns one stored document from the knowledge store.

GET /api/cli/download.name: Download the command-line tool
GET /api/cli/download.description: Serves the command-line tool that matches this platform version.

GET /api/cli/download/{CLI_DOWNLOAD_ALIA.name: Download with a file extension
GET /api/cli/download/{CLI_DOWNLOAD_ALIA.description: Serves the same command-line tool at an address that packaging tools accept.

GET /api/cli/artifacts/{filename}.name: Download a tool file
GET /api/cli/artifacts/{filename}.description: Serves a piece of the command-line tool that matches this platform build.

GET /api/sdk/download.name: Download the coding toolkit
GET /api/sdk/download.description: Packages the ready-made code that lets people's own programs talk to the platform.

POST /api/sdk/tables/create.name: Create a table
POST /api/sdk/tables/create.description: Sets up a new table for storing records from the command line.

POST /api/sdk/tables/list.name: List tables
POST /api/sdk/tables/list.description: Lists the tables the caller may see, within the scope they are allowed to use.

GET /api/config.name: Settings list
GET /api/config.description: Lists saved settings the signed-in person is allowed to see.

GET /api/config/{config_id}.name: Setting details
GET /api/config/{config_id}.description: Shows one saved setting by its identifier.

POST /api/config.name: Save a setting
POST /api/config.description: Stores a named setting value for the platform or an organization.

PUT /api/config/{config_id}.name: Update a setting
PUT /api/config/{config_id}.description: Changes the value of an existing setting.

DELETE /api/config/{config_id}.name: Delete a setting
DELETE /api/config/{config_id}.description: Removes a setting that is no longer used.

GET /api/decorator-properties.name: Trigger settings
GET /api/decorator-properties.description: Reads the settings written on a workflow's trigger line in its code.

PUT /api/decorator-properties.name: Change trigger settings
PUT /api/decorator-properties.description: Saves changes to a workflow trigger's settings, such as its schedule.

GET /api/dependencies/{entity_type}/{ent.name: Dependency map
GET /api/dependencies/{entity_type}/{ent.description: Shows everything a workflow, form, app or table is linked to, in both directions.

POST /api/dependencies/availability.name: Check for dependencies
POST /api/dependencies/availability.description: Tells you which of the chosen records have links worth showing on the map.

GET /api/llms.txt.name: Documentation for AI
GET /api/llms.txt.description: Serves all platform help pages as one document that AI assistants can read.
